title: About Adept
llmNone: No language model is used in this version. Plans, scores and SDG links are computed by deterministic, explainable rules.
llmCalls: {calls} model calls logged; {rejected} invented IDs rejected.
methodBody: Trend snapshots feed role outlooks under a moderate and a fast AI-disruption scenario. Matches combine skill overlap, trend outlook and interest fit. Pathways close your skills gap with courses from our catalogue only, ordered by prerequisites and trend-weighted priority, and timed from your hours per week. Every role and skill links to official SDG targets with a reason.
limitsBody: All predictions are estimates from public data. Your CV is read in memory and never stored. SDG links are drafts until a reviewer signs them off. Course levels are our estimate. Adept supports your decisions and never makes hiring decisions.
